summary:
Implemented the terminal window title feature by editing files only; nothing was run or committed, so tests, mypy and black are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE; ControlCode union now includes Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: formatting entry emits ESC ] 0 ; title BEL; new Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring, building one two-item code.
- rich/console.py: Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor; returns True after writing the control when is_terminal, else False; docstring covers restore limitation, terminal reset, and meaning of True.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calls term.set_title(title) with the second item (set_title already exists on the wrapper, left untouched).
- CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on Windows), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only).

Choices: title text is written unmodified; no exception handling around the wrapper call; no new imports in source files.
